summary: The prepared source already contains upstream commit 4ad990ba7, which fixes the reported class/interface failure by routing ordinary online modelopt_fp4 through DefaultModelLoader so the SGLang Gemma4 model is retained. No additional runtime source change was justified.

tests.what_was_measured: The failing-before/passing-after loader regression plus independent draft serialization/exclusion cases and explicit restore, save, and export workflow boundaries; 2 tests and 6 subtests passed.

Actual current get_model_loader selection is DefaultModelLoader for unquantized modelopt_fp4, the SGLang Gemma4 class exposes get_embed_and_head, the pre-fix predicate would select ModelOptModelLoader, and explicit ModelOpt workflows remain on ModelOptModelLoader.
The assigned environment has one AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950) under ROCm 7.2, not the NVIDIA CUDA/ModelOpt platform from the report.

gpu_execution_evidence: Only device inventory was collected. The issue-specific ModelOpt FP4 path was not executed because the assigned GPU is AMD gfx950/ROCm while the reported online ModelOpt NVFP4 path requires NVIDIA CUDA, and the 26B target/assistant weights were unavailable.
remaining_limitations: No full google/gemma-4-26B-A4B target plus assistant startup was run because the weights were unavailable.
No NVIDIA ModelOpt calibration or NVFP4 kernel execution was possible on the assigned AMD gfx950 GPU.
The evidence verifies loader routing and preservation of the SGLang model interface; it does not claim generation semantics, performance, or multi-node behavior.
